children: Sathlokhar Synergys E&C Global, an integrated EPC and turnkey construction company, reported that its net profit in the September quarter more than doubled to ₹29 crore, up from ₹14 crore in the same period last year, driven by strong execution and better margins.
Revenue also doubled year-on-year to ₹297 crore (₹148 crore).
The company secured 12 orders worth ₹353 crore in Q2, taking overall order inflows to ₹625 crore in the first half of this fiscal.
Its overall order book was at ₹1,139 crore as of September-end.
The company continues to strengthen client relationships through repeat orders from established customers, alongside adding new clients, it said.
G Thiyagu, Managing Director, Sathlokhar Synergys E&C Global, said the company has achieved revenue growth with a healthy EBITDA margin of 15 per cent.
Order inflows were also strong in the first half of this fiscal year, reflecting continued customer confidence, with repeat orders from established clients and new projects gaining momentum, he said.
The company has placed bids for projects worth ₹23,505 crore, representing a significant pool of opportunities across industries and geographies, he added.

As part of backward integration, the company has inaugurated a new PEB manufacturing facility at Pullivallam in Tamil Nadu. The plant has a designed production capacity of 1,200 tonnes per month at optimum utilisation.

The new plant allows the company to strengthen control over fabrication, quality and delivery timelines, while supporting both internal project requirements and potential external demand, said Thiyagu.
Focus on execution and profitable growth
Looking ahead, the company will focus on converting opportunities into quality orders, executing projects efficiently, and progressively scaling its PEB manufacturing capabilities.

“As we grow, we remain committed to maintaining execution discipline, improving operational efficiency and building lasting customer relationships to support sustainable, profitable growth over the long term,” he added.

title: Sathlokhar Synergys E&C Q2 net profit more than doubles to ₹29 crore
